glossary.role: The otherworld between sea and land where Dunbine takes place.
Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Aura battleship of Bishot Hatta, King of Ku; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Only appears as オーラノヴァ砲, the main cannon of the aura battleship Goraon.
Collective term for all aura-powered machines (Aura Battlers, aura ships) of the Drake Army.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Title Aura Battler; Sho's first unit; Marvel's playable unit in ACE2
Dotless form of バロン・ズゥ: Jonathan's/Quincy's powerful Antibody (also 巨大バロンズゥ).
Late-war Aura Battler of the Drake and Kingdom of Kuh side (Bishot Hate); Todd's unit in ACE2
Aura battleship of Elle Humm (Kingdom of Lao), armed with the Aura Nova Cannon
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack (also Mobile Suit Gundam, Zeta Gundam)
glossary.role: Earth Federation ace Newtype pilot; in CCA a Londo Bell mobile suit team leader (Captain) aboard the Ra Cailum and pilot of the Nu Gundam; Char's lifelong rival.
glossary.personality: Withdrawn, machine-obsessed teen in the original series; by CCA a mature, dependable veteran still bound up in his rivalry with Char.

glossary.role: Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Aura Fighter (not humanoid); the Black Knight's second unit in ACE2
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: American Holy Warrior summoned with Sho; fights for Drake and later Bishot Hate; pilots Wryneck in ACE2
glossary.personality: Brash and proud. At first he treats Byston Well as a game, then becomes obsessed with beating Sho to save his pride. Makes poor choices.

glossary.role: ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.note: army/MS rank; a ship's captain (艦長) is also Captain

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_02. Covers conclusion of Marina's retreat and Tak's exchange with Burning and Sinapus; the battle against Todd Guinness culminating in his Hyperization, dialogue with Show and Marvel, and death; Queen Ciela's tactical briefing regarding the Gea Garing and Will Wips; and Phase 2 mission dialogue escorting Golaon and coordinating its Aura Nova Cannon.
